summary: Callan JMB Inc. disclosed via Form 8-K that its subsidiary Callan Power LLC entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement to acquire 50% of The Pfanenstiel Company's oil and gas leases and wells in North Dakota and Montana for $12.5 million cash plus a $1 million escrow supplemental payment for drilling costs. Closing expected by September 30, 2026, subject to due diligence, financing, and regulatory approvals. No advisor or board recommendation mentioned. The deal implies a 50% working interest purchase; watch for financing completion and regulatory timing.
